title: Ansel and the House
author: Sable Delacroix
blurb: Rosalind Oyelaran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
